purpose: Post-submit experience for the Something Else fallback journey.
title: Your message is on its way to the right person.
body: We'll read what you shared and make sure it reaches the right Billbeak team, then continue using the contact details you provided.

whatHappensNext.label: We read your message
whatHappensNext.detail: Someone reviews what you're looking for.
